name: cyberhuatuo
description: CyberHuaTuo Codex plugin marketplace: when an agent gets sick, let it ask HuaTuo, fix the error, and keep the cure.

interface.shortDescription: When your agent gets sick, let it ask HuaTuo and keep the cure as a prescription.
interface.longDescription: CyberHuaTuo bundles Codex skills and MCP tools for the moment a coding agent gets sick: diagnose the traceback, apply the cure, then save or upload the solved case as a reusable prescription. A reviewed PreToolUse guard also checks destructive shell actions before execution; it is a deterministic guardrail, not a sandbox or complete enforcement boundary.
